summary: This is Snowflake documentation for the ALTER SECURITY INTEGRATION command as applied to Snowflake OAuth client integrations. It gives the syntax for setting or unsetting tags and for modifying partner-application and custom-client integrations, then describes each parameter with its defaults and allowed values. A short usage note warns against entering personal, sensitive or regulated data as metadata, and one example re-enables a suspended integration.
one_line: Snowflake reference for the ALTER SECURITY INTEGRATION command that modifies Snowflake OAuth partner and custom client integrations.
key_facts: ALTER SECURITY INTEGRATION modifies the properties of an existing security integration created for a Snowflake OAuth client.
For modifying other integration types such as External OAuth, the documentation points to a separate ALTER SECURITY INTEGRATION page.
The SET TAG and UNSET TAG syntax applies to security integrations, and a tag value is always a string with a maximum of 256 characters.
OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN_VALIDITY for partner applications accepts values from 86400 (1 day) to 7776000 (90 days), with a default of 7776000.
By default, OAUTH_ISSUE_REFRESH_TOKENS is TRUE, and setting it to FALSE means user consent is revoked and the user must confirm authorization again.
OAUTH_USE_SECONDARY_ROLES accepts IMPLICIT or NONE, and its default is NONE.
By default Snowflake prevents the ACCOUNTADMIN, ORGADMIN, and SECURITYADMIN roles from authenticating, and the account parameter must be set to FALSE to allow them.
For custom clients, OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI must be protected by TLS unless OAUTH_ALLOW_NON_TLS_REDIRECT_URI is set to TRUE, which defaults to FALSE.
OAUTH_ENFORCE_PKCE defaults to FALSE and determines whether Proof Key for Code Exchange is required for the integration.
PRE_AUTHORIZED_ROLES_LIST cannot include ACCOUNTADMIN, ORGADMIN, or SECURITYADMIN and is supported for confidential clients only.
For Tableau Desktop, refresh token validity ranges from 60 seconds to 36000 seconds (10 hours), with a default of 36000.
For Tableau Server or Tableau Online, refresh token validity ranges from 60 seconds to 7776000 seconds (90 days), with a default of 7776000.
For custom clients, refresh token validity ranges from 86400 seconds (1 day) to 7776000 seconds (90 days), with a default of 7776000.
The NETWORK_POLICY parameter controls network traffic that tries to exchange an authorization code or use a refresh token.
The example 'ALTER SECURITY INTEGRATION myint SET ENABLED = TRUE;' initiates operation of a suspended integration.
